topic: The white-label client portal — what a Sanad office's clients see when they log in
format: Lead with a quote or question from a customer, then explain the feature built in response
post:
"Can our clients see their own documents without calling us every time?"

That question came from a Sanad office manager in Muscat. It's the same question SmartPRO Hub kept hearing from PRO service firms across Oman.

So we built the answer into the platform.

Every Sanad office on SmartPRO Hub can give their business clients a branded client portal — the client's logo, their colors, their name on the login screen.

When a client logs in, they see exactly what they need:

Active work permits and visa status in real time.
Uploaded documents and contracts — no chasing emails.
Invoice history and payment records, all in one place.

No more calls asking "where is my employee's visa?"
No more WhatsApp threads with 40 attachments and zero context.

The portal is white-labeled — so your clients interact with your brand, not ours. SmartPRO Hub sits behind the scenes.

For HR managers and ops directors evaluating Sanad office management software, this is the difference between a vendor and a system that actually reduces their workload.

Your clients become more self-sufficient. Your team stops answering the same status questions three times a day.

What do your clients currently call or message you about most — and how much time does that actually take per week?
